title: The viewer keeps an shm fallback for a background buffer
body:
`viewer.rs` draws its 1 by 1 background with `wp_single_pixel_buffer_manager_v1` and falls back to an 18-line memfd and `wl_shm` path on hosts without it, which is why `WlShm` and `WlShmPool` appear in the `no_events!` list. The viewer already requires viewporter and linux-dmabuf v4 through `missing()`.

## Proposal

Require single-pixel-buffer the same way and drop the fallback and the two shm types. A host-compatibility choice: every compositor decade is likely to run under has the protocol, but I have not checked which hosts lack it.
